title.en: Apple begins the beta rollout of Siri AI with iOS 27
title.zhHans: Apple 随 iOS 27 开始测试版推出 Siri AI

searchSummary.en: Apple began rolling out Siri AI in beta with iOS 27 on September 14; the first release is opt-in, English-only, and initially unavailable in the EU and China.
searchSummary.zhHans: Apple 于 9 月 14 日随 iOS 27 开始测试版推出 Siri AI；首发版本需选择加入、仅支持英语，且暂不在欧盟和中国提供。

summary.en: Apple first announced its rebuilt Siri AI at WWDC on June 8, 2026. On September 14, the company began rolling out Siri AI in beta with iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The release adds personal-context understanding, onscreen awareness, app actions, and a new Siri app. Apple says the first rollout is in English, requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled device and opt-in, and is initially unavailable in the EU and China.
summary.zhHans: Apple 于 2026 年 6 月 8 日在 WWDC 首次宣布重建 Siri AI。9 月 14 日，公司随 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27 和 visionOS 27 开始测试版推出 Siri AI。更新加入个人上下文理解、屏幕内容感知、跨应用操作和新的 Siri 应用。Apple 表示，首轮推出仅支持英语，需要启用 Apple Intelligence 的设备并选择加入，且暂不在欧盟和中国提供。

narrative.en: The September release turns the June announcement into a user-facing beta rather than a general-availability launch. Apple describes a system orchestrator that can use on-device indexes and app tools, while more complex features may rely on server-side models and daily limits. CNBC reports that users may need to join a waitlist and that the regional rollout excludes the EU and China at first. Apple lists French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish as coming the following month. This update records a constrained rollout and does not support claims of broad adoption or universal device coverage.
narrative.zhHans: 9 月发布将 6 月的宣布转化为面向用户的测试版，而不是正式全面发布。Apple 描述了可使用设备端索引和应用工具的系统编排器；更复杂的功能可能依赖服务器端模型，并受到每日限额约束。CNBC 报道称，用户可能需要加入等待名单，首轮区域推出不包括欧盟和中国。Apple 列出法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语将于次月推出。本更新记录的是受限 rollout，不支持广泛采用或覆盖所有设备的说法。

description.en: Moves the Siri AI features announced at WWDC into a user-facing beta with personal context, onscreen awareness, and systemwide app actions.
description.zhHans: 将 WWDC 宣布的 Siri AI 功能推进到面向用户的测试版，加入个人上下文、屏幕内容感知和系统级应用操作。

description.en: Puts the announced assistant capabilities into Apple's operating-system distribution path, while the beta, language, device, and regional gates limit initial access.
description.zhHans: 将已宣布的助手能力纳入 Apple 操作系统分发路径，但测试版、语言、设备和地区限制约束了初始访问。

text.en: Apple began rolling out Siri AI in beta on September 14 with iOS 27 and related operating-system updates, following the June 8 WWDC announcement.
text.zhHans: Apple 于 9 月 14 日随 iOS 27 及相关系统更新开始测试版推出 Siri AI，此前公司已于 6 月 8 日在 WWDC 宣布该功能。

text.en: The beta includes personal-context understanding, onscreen awareness, app actions, and a new Siri app that stores prior queries.
text.zhHans: 该测试版包含个人上下文理解、屏幕内容感知、应用操作，以及可保存此前查询的新 Siri 应用。

text.en: Siri AI initially requires opt-in and may require a waitlist, launches in English, is initially unavailable in the EU and China, and is subject to device and usage limits.
text.zhHans: Siri AI 首发需要选择加入且可能需要等待名单，仅支持英语，暂不在欧盟和中国提供，并受到设备和使用限额约束。
